name: xp-part-finder
description: Admin application for Enonic XP 7 that helps find and rename components across content repositories

features.Component-finder: Scans XP data repositories to identify which content items use specific codebase-defined components (parts, layouts, fragments) and displays this information in a navigable UI
features.Component-mover: Provides interface to selectively rename components across content items with undo functionality and custom postprocessing capabilities

functionality: Repository scanning and component usage analysis
Change history tracking with undo functionality
Custom postprocessor modules for modifying changed components
Atomic operations to ensure data integrity: if anything fails in the editor, no changes are made to the data
unsolved: Fix typescript issues around the editor in order to aid postprocessor building
Duplicate selected components (and add them right below the old one) instead of just renaming them
If duplication can't be solved, then how to undo: reverting components to their original state even after postprocessing
